resources.string: Each alias is its own address that delivers here. Give one to a single site, and turn it off when that site leaks it. Turning one off or on asks for a key that approves devices.
No aliases yet. Make one for the next site that asks for your address.
Missing. The server no longer has it, so mail to it is refused.
Turn off this alias? Mail to it will be refused.
Up to 20 lowercase letters, digits or dashes. The server adds a random tag after it.
Waiting for a key that approves devices.
This server has aliases switched off.
A label is 1 to 20 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
The server is at its alias limit: 400 on, 1000 made, or 20 made in the last hour.
400 aliases are already on. Turn one off first.
The mail server is busy. Try again in a minute.
The mail server refused or failed the request.
The server did not accept this session.
That key does not approve devices, or the sign-in was not accepted.
The server no longer holds that alias.
